Name: Shannon Bicksler
Badge: Reading to Write: Say-Mean-Matter
How might you introduce Say-Mean-Matter to your students? What about this framework do you think will be helpful for them? What might be challenging?:

I think I like the idea of starting with quotes like we did here. I also think we could possibly use pictures or maybe science related advertisements and have students use the say-mean-matter strategy. I think it will help students to think deeper into the meaning and why they think it is important. For instance, if I were to use the science advertisements then they could hopefully use the "matter" part to explain the science concept behind it. I think that would probably be the most challenging part for them. Just the deeper thinking instead of stopping at "what does this mean?" I think they might also try to say the same thing for the mean and matter part.
